# σ-algebra generated by a tail of a sequence of σ-algebras

**σ-algebra generated by a tail of a sequence of σ-algebras.** Given σ-algebras
$\mathcal{A}_0, \mathcal{A}_1, \dots$ on $\Omega$ and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, this is
$\sigma(\mathcal{A}_n, \mathcal{A}_{n+1}, \dots)$, the smallest σ-algebra on $\Omega$
containing every $\mathcal{A}_i$ with $i \ge n$.
